laws.rule: Chongqing Jiangbei airport is a 240-hour visa-free transit port; the permitted area is all of Chongqing.

Smoking is banned indoors in public places (restaurants, hotels and entertainment venues may set up a smoking area) (article 8). It is also banned in the outdoor areas of schools and children's venues, women's and children's hospitals, public sports and fitness venues, performance venues and public transport waiting areas (article 9). A person who smokes in a banned public place is ordered to stop (article 19).
laws.penalty_signal: Fine CNY 50 (about A$10.67); CNY 200 (about A$42.66) if the person does not stop. (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 重庆市公共场所控制吸烟条例 (Chongqing Public Places Tobacco Control Regulation)

laws.rule: Setting off fireworks is banned inside the Ring Expressway (including the road) and in the built-up areas of listed outer districts (article 5). It is also banned at listed places such as schools, hospitals and heritage sites (article 6). The regulation came into force on 15 August 2026.
laws.penalty_signal: Fine CNY 100 to 200 (about A$21.33 to A$42.66); CNY 200 to 500 (about A$42.66 to A$107) in serious cases (article 17). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 重庆市燃放烟花爆竹管理条例 (Chongqing Fireworks Setting-off Management Regulation)

laws.rule: In scenic areas, smoking or lighting a fire in a fire-ban zone is banned (article 26). The management body orders it to stop.
laws.penalty_signal: Fine CNY 100 to 1,000 (about A$21.33 to A$213) (article 42). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 重庆市风景名胜区条例 (Chongqing Scenic Areas Regulation)
